853:t_46:4.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「As one of the $$トライスター$$, I'd say this result is only natural.」

853:t_46:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is impressive. The $$トライスター$$ are normally a trio, but you tried for stardom all on your own...」

853:t_46:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The rule is that you never tell this kind of joke twice. Things don't always work out, $$ナイジェル$$.」

853:t_46:8.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Tch... I was an idiot to try to take this guy seriously...」

853:t_47:4.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Yes... Somehow I've managed to uphold $$エコーズ$$'s prestige since Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$'s death.」

853:t_47:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is impressive, $$コンロイ$$. I apologize for thinking you were just a dull old man.」

853:t_47:6.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「We normally operate behind the scenes! That is why we make a point of keeping a low profile!」

853:t_47:7.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Besides, $c has people who can fight on foot even better than we can, so opportunities to shine are inevitably...」

853:t_47:8.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「No, it is wrong to think about shining at all...! In the first place, $$エコーズ$$ is...」

853:t_47:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Ah... It seems I have opened a forbidden door that should have stayed shut...)

853:t_48:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've prepared some ice cream to celebrate.」

853:t_48:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You live up to your reputation as a dimensional trader. You even knew my favorite food.」

853:t_48:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, please... Seeing that smile is the greatest reward I could ask for.」

853:t_49:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's because I know you'll use the celebration as an excuse to sexually harass me!」

853:t_49:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Trying to win my sympathy like that won't work!」

853:t_49:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... even prepared a present to make you happy, $$ノリコ$$.」

853:t_49:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Huh? You have a present for me!」

853:t_49:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, some special-effects show discs that I thought you would like, $$ノリコ$$...」

853:t_49:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... That thank-you came from the heart this time.」

853:t_49:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... I doubt she'll be so grateful when she learns I swapped the contents of those discs for my private collection...)

853:t_49:15.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's get all the girls together to watch them! I'll use this chance to get everyone hooked!」

853:t_49:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Ah... It seems I'll be the one getting stuck in a quagmire instead...)

853:t_50:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But why are you congratulating me from so far away?」

853:t_50:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I heard you use ace pilot celebrations to sexually harass girls, $$ＡＧ$$, but you won't come near $$ノノ$$...」

853:t_50:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Of course sexual harassment is unacceptable, but is $$ノノ$$ really that unattractive...?」

853:t_50:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I apologize, $$ノノ$$! If you put it that way, I'll steel myself too!」

853:t_50:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, in answer to your request, I'll help myself to...」

853:t_50:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ won't allow anything dirty!」

853:t_50:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This... is what I was afraid of...」
